name: Antidote
doc: Antidote (battle item): one prim-model layout played on the target, at the middle of its height; the target takes the result when the layout ends. One of the five status-cure item modules (292 Soft, 293 Eye Drops, 294 Antidote, 295 Echo Screen, 296 Holy Water: one source built with different options).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

resources.doc: No camera track: Antidote starts none.

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the master alternates, the layout's blended vertex frames (right after the play node).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root task's clock: when the sound plays (draws nothing)

parts.title: Layout
parts.doc: The layout played on the target; target 0 takes the result when it ends

groups.label: Anchor height
groups.doc: The anchor: the target's effect position, y = its +0x24 word + its height x Times / Share (y goes down)

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays when the root tick == this (the layout starts at root tick 1)

params.label: Sound pan
params.doc: Where it plays between the speakers: 128 the middle (BdPlaySE's pan)

params.label: Depth
params.doc: Added to its drawing depth (sort key)

tasks.doc: The layout at the anchor on target 0 of action 0, each object's offset added to it, through the camera (record flags 0x40000: YXZ angles, 0x8000: not turned with the camera); when it ends, target 0 takes the result.
